notes.title: The final release of Organs Please is now available!
notes.notes:
Greetings. 

The Human Survival Committee announces the full opening of the Human Recycling Factory and the final leg of the Ark's construction. 

If you've been doubting whether to join this legendary mission to save mankind, now is the time to make your decision. In these difficult times for all humanity, the Committee needs each and every one of you to save the last survivors on Earth and to lay the foundation for a new future on Planet 42. 

[previewyoutube=FOBCyYGW0-Y;full][/previewyoutube]

In the final update for Organs Please, you will have the fifth story week that includes new challenges and difficult decisions to make. Should you let visitors in who have strange parasites on their heads?

The new checkpoint mechanics will make you sweat as you'll have to meet the deadline for the construction plan, while pleasing the Committee and avoiding being recycled. 

Can you do it? We hope you can! 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_a3f7bb399f9b485c80b60ba0453aa332~mv2.gif[/img]

You'll meet with various representatives of the different Factions, all of whom will slam you with requests and try to persuade you to take their side. In this update, your relationship with each Faction will deepen and become more interesting. 

The Faction Paths will open up, each of which significantly changes the course of the game and affects the ending. After selecting the faction paths, special Faction Factory Sections that produce unique goods will also become available to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/e6b8d5195d9ab3860a5460858506beb4a2529a47.png[/img]

All the choices you make during the game will unlock one of several endings. What will happen as the Human Survival Committee and the Factions are getting ready to leave Earth? You'll find out after the Organs Please update.

And the new events at the Factory will bring more variety to the Manager's routine work, along with additional achievements to motivate you into playing more. 

Update Organs Please to start your new duties as the Factory Manager. Don't forget to join the game's community on [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url], and leave feedback on the game's Steam page. 

See you on the new planet or the renewed Earth? Who knows! 

Regards,
Organs Please Team

notes.title: We're dropping a new update for Twitch streamers!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

The Human Survival Committee is proud to announce the release of a brand new update that wasn't in Organs Please.

Firstly, for those who love to stream on Twitch, we have added a new feature that allows your viewers to decide the fate of visitors in the game. All you need to do is press a special button and your viewers can choose between allowing the person onto the Ark, hiring them as a Factory worker, or even incinerating them – you'll have to follow their choice.
 
Surviving in a post-apocalyptic and bloodthirsty society just became a little more fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/32bbd7cda8893f492d742a0cfa19d796b014bd44.jpg[/img]

Secondly, we have implemented a survey system for all viewers. Between 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. every game day, your Twitch viewers can vote on whether to take positive or negative action against the Factory Administrator (in other words, you!).

They can give you humanitarian aid in the form of property and lives, a cash bonus, or an increase in assembly parts for the Ark.

But you should be careful, because they can also activate unexpected inspections or close important areas of the Factory. You'd better do your best to stay on their good side.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_e0676c2ad6e84713aa2eba8906eefaf8~mv2.gif[/img]

Lastly, in addition to deciding the fate of ordinary citizens, players will also be able to decide the fate of celebrities, including famous murderers, cannibals (not just Virtus Populi followers!), maniacs, space travelers, and political figures. Who will you save and who will you turn into food for the rest of Vert-5? We can't wait to see!

Furthermore, we have completely updated all Faction Principles, fine-tuned the balance, and added even more variety to the appearances of normal and faction visitors.

We hope you enjoy it! Please share your impressions here or on [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url] – the Human Survival Committee is always open to receive suggestions and feedback. 

Regards,
Organs Please Team

notes.title: Fungal Threat, Little Horror Farm, and more in the Organs Please update!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

The Human Survival Committee is happy to see everyone who survived the harsh factory life from last year. But it's too soon to relax. Next week, you will face new challenges and will need to make some very tough decisions. What exactly will you have to deal with?

The fourth week of the Organs Please storyline will begin. It will feature even more inspectors and unscheduled tasks, tough Faction orders, and a range of other duties for the Factory administrator to complete.

The Factions have already prepared a list of 18 new quests. And the Human Survival Committee will put you in charge of fighting the mushroom infection. Be careful not to touch anyone, because they might just seem like a fun guy.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_d52eaa1441d14260bd0050abe09a81b2~mv2.gif[/img]

The Syndicate will need your help to combat their competition, while the Virtus Populi is organizing a mass festival to celebrate the upcoming departure, and the Government is fighting the disgruntled in very peculiar ways.

The Hands of Earth and the Revolutionary brigade take their fight to a new level and restore the planet's ecosystem. Will you create a Little Horror Farm and breed future flora, or grow bushes right on the heads of the government fools? We don't even know which to choose.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_c5e22870c2ce4d50aa4a3cc88bc02db8~mv2.gif[/img]

The Revolutionary brigade is even willing to get its hands dirty… including yours. It's time to decide whose side you're on. Speaking of which…

In this update, the Faction Principles levels 7 and 8 will open up once you reach level 8. You'll have to decide who you'll support and choose a Faction Path. We caution you to act wisely as there will be no turning back.

In addition to the big gameplay elements, we've finished working on the sound effects for the week 4 mechanics. We hope you'll love it… or we'll recycle you.

Download the build from Steam; play and share your impressions with us! As a reminder, you can get in touch with the Committee [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1593780/discussions/]in the discussions on Steam[/url] or in [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url].

Regards,
Organs Please Team

notes.title: Nominate Organs Please in the Steam Awards 2022!
notes.notes:
Organs Please is a satirical game with fun casual graphics, a surreal storyline, and multiple endings.

The sound is not just “there” in the game, but it complements and finishes what the game designer intended — the main idea was to create a counterpoint between something “serious/complex” and “funny/light”. After all, the player works at a human recycling plant in order to build a space ark from the materials obtained.

This sounds intimidating, but the graphics, the appearance of the visitors, and the narrative make it clear that this is satire. And the sound has become one of the important elements of this reality.

The search for a suitable genre was carried out for a long time — such genres as jazz, acid jazz, doom jazz, lounge, and experimental were taken as references. As a result, we created something special that fits into the game as cool as possible and supports the original idea: complex harmonies, interesting melodies, and broken rhythms — all this is opposed to casual graphics and narrative.

If you liked what we came up with, nominate Organs Please in the "Best Soundtrack" category at the Steam Awards 2022!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/2e332f878f2000b124aebc8e3bf55574c5c93b9e.png[/img]

notes.title: Grand Opening of the Factory and Plans of the Committee!
notes.notes:
Greetings! 

The celebratory ribbon has been cut, the workers are ready for their assignments, the workshops are running, and the Factory administrator's office is waiting for you. You have thirty days to build the Ark, the spaceship that will carry humanity to our new home: Planet 42.

[previewyoutube=jrmLEzxueFo;full][/previewyoutube]

Let's see what you'll encounter during this difficult thirty-day challenge. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/a804c3ad13d13901bce16323154aed7d075518ac.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Early Access release[/b][/h3]

You'll be able to play [i][b]through the first and second story weeks[/b][/i] of Organs Please. These will teach you [b][i]the basic mechanics of checking visitors at the checkpoint.[/i][/b] Be on the lookout for terrorists armed with bombs, make sure to test potential colonists with your trusty spoon, and so much more. 

Open up [b][i]ten basic Resource Factory Sections[/i][/b] and [b][i]three Goods Sections[/i][/b]. As the Administrator, you will have to provide the factions and inhabitants of the Ark with food, clothing, and other necessities. 

As the Factory administrator, you will also learn [b][i]the fundamental Faction Principles[/i][/b] and begin to apply them to your work.

Do not disappoint us or you will be recycled. This is your only warning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/470b17f1c875ca435aa8600d2c393d38319c6f60.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Update 1[/b][/h3]

[b][i]The third story week of the game[/i][/b] will be available in Update 1, during which [b][i]an epidemic[/i][/b] will break out at the Factory. You will have [b][i]to forcibly vaccinate[/i][/b] every colonist and worker. This gigantic task is not an easy one – people are outraged – so we will allocate you [b][i]a stun[/i][/b] gun to help keep order. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/d9955534899b3b8e2e4d87958006fe75dd4a3d90.jpg[/img]

The Government is also determined [b][i]to test a control chip[/i][/b], and the other Factions with [b][i]new story quests[/i][/b] are waiting for their hour.

[b][i]Two more checkpoint mechanics[/i][/b] will also be available. The Save Humanity Committee is keeping these a secret for now. 

As the Factory administrator, you will also have access to [b][i]the new Faction Principles[/i][/b], including “Behavior Correction” from the Government and “Contraband” from the Tricelli Syndicate.

[b][i]Additional Goods Sections[/i][/b] are also scheduled to open this week by the Committee: “Durable fiber”, “Polymers”, and two more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/4dd304c8ac1a988870b11ba3ab65ed5ca8ffd154.jpg[/img]

As you can see, the third week will be full of exciting… or outlandish events. We will not bother you with the details of [b][i]new events at the Factory[/i][/b] and the description of [b][i]new achievements.[/i][/b] Instead, we will let them be a pleasant (or not so pleasant) surprise for you.

[h3][b]Update 2[/b][/h3]

Update 2 introduces [b][i]the fourth story week[/i][/b] of the game, in which you must [b][i]remove chips[/i][/b], [b][i]check visitors with a Geiger counter,[/i][/b] and [b][i]more[/i][/b] to secure the Ark and the Factory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/4750033a3352f49b9211a46fd059a799fd056817.jpg[/img]

Be sure to develop relationships with all of the Factions to unlock [b][i]new principals:[/i][/b] “Illegal recreational practices” from the Syndicate, “Underground People” from the Hands of Earth, and more.

[b][i]Another Goods Section[/i][/b] will begin operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/22b1a4c423e52ae03e4165f2708e4c91bbef9e9b.jpg[/img]

There will be brand [b][i]new quests[/i][/b]. The mission to save humanity is threatened by [b][i]a mushroom infection[/i][/b], [b][i]radiation[/i][/b] and [b][i]mutants[/i][/b], the Syndicate [b][i]takes revenge[/i][/b] for disrupted business, the Hands of Earth prepares [b][i]an epochal exposure[/i][/b], and that's not all!

Don't expect to sit quietly at the checkpoint: [b][i]new events at the Factory[/i][/b] won't let your work turn into a routine. But the better you do, the more likely you are to earn [b][i]more achievements.
[/i][/b]

[h3][b]Full release[/b][/h3]

In the Full Release, we will open [i][b]the fifth and final week of the Organs Please storyline[/b][/i]. The fifth story week prepares new challenges for the Factory administrator, and all the hard choices throughout the game will culminate into one of[b][i] several finales.[/i][/b]

If you're hoping to exhale before completing the Ark, you're mistaken. The inhabitants of the Vert-5 are being overrun by new plagues: [i][b]brain slugs[/b][/i] and [i][b]vermin.[/b][/i] And you'll have to work extra hard to get rid of these.

Moreover, [b][i]four new checkpoint mechanics[/i][/b] will be added to ensure that only the most deserving are let onto the Ark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/96dc4619d22a5b236eda07f80a7242fe106c9928.png[/img]

Relationships with the different Factions will reach a whole new level. [b][i]Faction Paths[/i][/b] will open up, each of which significantly changes the course of the game.

You will be able to open [b][i]special Faction Factory Sections[/i][/b] that produce unique faction goods.

You won't get bored with the next [b][i]new Factory events[/i][/b] and [b][i]new achievements[/i][/b].

And finally, [b][i]the final quest:[/i][/b] The Human Survival Committee and each Faction are getting ready to depart. What will happen? The plot depends on the Faction Path you choose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/8f9fcf0c5a322d167a60526343725e26f8f55c46.jpg[/img]

As you can see, the thirty days from the opening of the Factory to the tightening of the last nut in the Ark will be filled with events, challenges, and encounters with extraordinary heroes. We hope you have fun and enjoy playing Organs Please.

We're open to comments and suggestions, which you can share in [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1593780/discussions/]the Steam Discussions[/url]. The Human Survival Committee considers all appeals. 

Regards,
Organs Please Team

notes.title: Factory ASMR
notes.notes:
Greetings, overseer! 

We hope you are ready to successfully complete the upcoming production of the Ark spacecraft in Organs Please… because if you screw up, we'll recycle you. Now that we have your attention, we must discuss the sound effects we created for the game.

As you are no doubt aware, Organs Please is a satirical anti-utopia about the impending destruction of Earth, and the recycling of people. But that does not mean that we have taken our jobs lightly. In fact, we have created the best sound effects that the human cattle... we mean 'players'... will love. The combination of a jazz soundtrack with cartoony sci-fi sounds will draw you right into the comedic (and depressing) world of Organs Please.

There are 4 different sound types in the game: voices, checkpoints, the factory, and the UI.
[previewyoutube=yaxStkHWa6Q;full][/previewyoutube]
We needed to make sure the visitors' voices were clearly distinguishable while other sounds played out. So, we decided to make them comically cartoony. All of the visitor greetings and reactions should put a smile on your face. In fact, we urge you to smile because we are watching at all times.

[previewyoutube=FWQxaRb3cDg;full][/previewyoutube]

We decided to take a different route for the voices of the faction representatives. They are still cartoony, but distinct enough to compliment each character. Their voices are squeaky, sly, and at times even annoying. They offer various “deals of conscience” to the player, and we emphasized this as much as possible with the sounds.

[previewyoutube=wgZ1sg17V7c;full][/previewyoutube]
Every single element of the checkpoint has its own sound. From the visitor scanner to the rustling of documents, and even the pulling of levers to incinerate people – we spared no expense when it came to the atmosphere of the room. The sounds will change depending on the time of day so you don't need to look at the clock. When the end of your shift approaches, the speed of the sounds will intensify to signal that you are running out of time. 

Tell us in the comments what you think of the sounds, meatbag. Don't forget to add Organs Please to your Steam Wishlist and join our [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url] for more info.

Regards,
Organs Please team

notes.title: You won't believe what's going on at the Factory!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

We, the Hands of Earth, are appealing to all the citizens of Vertical-5! The Human Survival Committee is hiding the truth from you. They promise you salvation from imminent doom, but this is not true. If we all unite, we can revive the Earth and build a new future together.

Our artist, under the guise of a mere worker, has managed to infiltrate the Factory. Thanks to their bravery, today we will tell you the truth about what is really going on there. The Committee claims that the construction of the Ark is going according to plan and that no sacrifice is in vain, but this is all a shameless lie!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/f4fc429ab42b699b1534fb4b5a233e4afa9ae333.jpg[/img]

There is only madness in the Factory - the workshops are messy, the employees are pursuing their own petty interests and care nothing for the salvation of mankind.

To balance the existential horror of recycling people with humor, our artist chose a light and comical style for his drawings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/3883620712ecf8671911709fc687979b20531066.jpg[/img]

People are on edge because of the endless string of chopped-up bodies and hellish working conditions. Many work several shifts in a row, making them aggressive and angry. You can get thrown in the meat grinder for eating someone else's lunch or being a few seconds late to your shift. Is this the future that we all dream of?

The Committee tells all of Vert-5 about friendly teams and a co-ordinated workforce. In reality, your colleague is ready to tear your throat out for a raise, and anyone who disagrees with the Committee's policies is sent to the furnace. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/7d7bb183b0c88926e0052f9074b2b9446a5d255f.png[/img]

The main inspiration for this illustration is a famous meme. We used to laugh at it, but now it best reflects the tragedy of our reality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/6c2f767a8cf703f8408d9bdd2a3eab6c6d3ce843.jpg[/img]

In the Factory, as within any office, rats – or office gossips – nest and weave a web of lies about you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/645c83fb3cc25777f477a4883adb927eac085875.png[/img]

To illustrate this, we used Mel Gibson's smug look in Maverick. The look is so charismatic that it deserves a whole gallery of portraits! We hope you noticed them on the wall. The Committee allocated a separate budget to print the pictures, when it could have spent the money on new overalls for the staff or catering at the Factory. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/9b70a9221a61bf764583121a83dc4b7ac2ef7bc2.jpg[/img]

Very aggressive employees might fight amongst themselves for the right to work an extra shift or a nude photo of a Miss Ark contestant. The moral decay is disgusting! And you still have hope that these people will save the Earth from destruction?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/fe9f74582759f4ed0101661b9718727fce649be1.png[/img]

We used memes and footage from The Simpsons to prepare for the fights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/82b74f00e2f4fafb3e8cdea5d8d595b8000ec881.png[/img]

Some employees take their hand-to-hand combat training seriously and practice between shifts at the Factory. One of them even has a coach, and fan of the movie Rocky – he bought himself a suit just like it. Did you find him in the crowd? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/498a241fb7e37c3a604b548307b5ec820948a9f3.jpg[/img]

Sometimes, events at the Factory lead to chaos. It's remarkable how stupid some workers are. The Committee claims to hire only highly qualified people, but, in fact, all of them have already been recycled or fled to other Verticals. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/d165728cdf277d204303b9a45f6203481863aee0.png[/img]

Surely, their idol is Patrick. Who else could fail such simple tasks? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/0dcb225c2e33dc11ba294337eb80c8fcc377ebc2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/248d7107f8fda5204528750863e436b07d032e78.jpg[/img]

Unfortunately, the Factory isn't running optimally and often has breakdowns. The engineering employee looks at the cog in detail, as if he's seeing it for the first time. We think he lied in his CV and in the interview! 

And while the furnace "boils with rage," the shop workers scatter like ants. Some of them will be recycled today, so that new "candidates" can be selected tomorrow. 

Please [url=https://www.instagram.com/shvedochko/]support our artist[/url] with his difficult opposition activities. Fearing persecution, he fled Vert-5 yesterday.

Add Organs Please to your Steam Wishlist, subscribe to [url=https://discord.gg/3kSY3M49n5]our Discord[/url], and help us save the Earth and humanity! 


With hope,
Hands of Earth

notes.title: Principles of the different Factions
notes.notes:
Hello, overseer!

We invite you to read about the fundamental principles of the different factions. Aligning with any of the factions in Organs Please will open up new opportunities for the Factory.

There are two ways to earn the trust of a faction: 

Complete special faction tasks. If you assist the Government and recycle undesirable persons, you will receive a point from them. Help collect on a debt and the Tricelli Syndicate will look upon you with favour. 

Fulfill faction orders in the factory. Source some bone jelly from a few undesirables and the Virtus Populi will award you with a faction point. 

In addition, you will have to prove your loyalty to the faction by giving its followers free passage to the Ark. 

When you have gained enough faction points – and enough of a faction’s followers are on the Ark –  you will unlock the relevant faction principle. Remember, if the number of faction followers on the Ark decreases, you will lose access to the principle as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/c7b6cf6d56734a1f621c63f6b182c1640492d358.jpg[/img]

[b]The Guided Principles [/b]

Each faction is also guided by the tenets that underlie its operating principles.

The Government encourages workaholism and will squeeze every ounce of life out of workers, much like a real government. If you can't work anymore, you will be recycled. No one is irreplaceable – there is a line of people who want to work at the Factory. A representative for the Government will gladly work the first shift for free. They will also rat out other employees and report any individual who does not perform well. Recycling such a colleague will increase the snitch's productivity by 200% for the rest of the day. 

The adherents of the Virtus Populi are true fanatics and consider recycling people to be the true will of their God. Through the power of faith, they work faster and increase the processing rate. As an additional faction bonus - you will be able to gain two extra hours to fulfill a particularly challenging order.

The power of the Hands of Earth is in unity and quantity. The more people who join the movement, the stronger it is. If you share their principles, you can hire two faction members instead of one regular employee. The faction’s vast intelligence network will also let you know about Ark orders in advance.

And, finally, Tricelli Syndicate members will stop at nothing to achieve their goal. When the mafia rules the Factory, employees handle stress better and even channel it to increase efficiency. You also receive extra bodies in the storage room every morning. Just don't ask unnecessary questions, or you'll find yourself among them. 

Needless to say, that's not all the factions have to offer you. Navigating the murky world of politics and balancing relationships with factions is a difficult task indeed. Good luck, overseer!

Respectfully,
Committee of State Vigilance

notes.title: Productivity is your responsibility
notes.notes:
Hello, overseer!

We have noticed a slack in the order schedule, which means that Ark's mission is in serious trouble! In order to improve the efficiency of the factory, the Human Survival Committee has made corrections to the production process. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/57d3dfec0751b95f61518dc2513ab121ca2cc126.png[/img]

Your top priority is to focus on orders to build the Ark, you will receive these tasks every day. And orders that aren't completed in a timely manner will accumulate and put humanity's salvation in danger. If this happens, the Committee may decide that you are not up to the task and you will be replaced by a more capable worker.

You will also have to shoulder the burden of providing the Ark with everything it needs. Occasionally there will be orders for food for the colonists, which must also be treated as high-priority.

The workload on the Factory will increase gradually. In order to meet the quota, you'll have to expand production, build new facilities, and improve the existing ones. All of this requires money, which can be obtained by fulfilling commodity and resource orders from the various fractions. Prioritizing the orders is entirely your responsibility as an overseer: reallocate staff for urgent orders or save up resources for future orders.

Every order, with the exception of Ark construction tasks, now has a strict deadline. If you fail to meet the deadline, the order will disappear and you won't receive any reward.

Manage the orders correctly, overseer, or you will be recycled.

Respectfully,
Committee of State Vigilance

notes.title: New Game Teaser
notes.notes:
Hello, overseer!

We have noticed reduced factory productivity recently and have decided to release a new video to... motivate you. Don't forget the importance of your mission to save humanity!

[previewyoutube=WmYganEVdqU;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you'll now do your duties with dignity! It's either that or being recycled and used for spare parts.

Respectfully,
Committee of State Vigilance

notes.title: Upgrade today for survival tomorrow
notes.notes:
Hello, overseer!

Thanks to the active work of the Human Survival Committee, our workshops have been modernized and the productivity of the Factory has increased. We are now one step closer to our goal of completing the Ark and escaping to Planet 42.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/30557124e7b46b758852c2c96137792eb6c746c9.png[/img]

The workshops are now divided into Resource and Commodity facilities. 

The Resource Workshop extracts basic resources from human bodies: hair, blood, skin, meat, or bones. These are needed to fulfil orders for the various factions and to complete the Ark. With more advanced workshops, you can produce more complicated resources like steamed blood, bone jelly, and more.

The Commodity Workshops produce goods, which are created from two types of resources. Just make sure you have enough of the necessary materials in storage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/5fd9f3ded3f5d2559430af43e0c272b04821d698.png[/img]

Every workshop can be upgraded, which will lead to an increase in productivity and additional places for workers.

Overseer, we expect you to give 200% to your job. If not, well… would you like to see the inside of the Resource Workshop? 

Respectfully,
Committee of State Vigilance

notes.title: The four factions of Vert-5
notes.notes:
Hello there, employee!

The queue for the Ark is backed up today and it looks like all four factions are out in support. The Government, Virtus Populi, the Tricelli Syndicate and even those pesky rebels from “Hands of Earth” are here to put extra pressure on you and the rest of the citizens to side with one of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/8b0a38e9a26a06f2fba572873b9b8cd8aa1cbb0b.png[/img]

All of the factions are handing out leaflets to show off their distinctive elements and to bolster their ranks. We advise you to study each of the leaflets carefully. Refer to these documents if there is any doubt as to what faction a checkpoint visitor’s allegiances lie with. 

Respectfully,
Committee of State Vigilance

notes.title: Your responsibilities until the end of days
notes.notes:
Hello, new employee!

We hope you have had a chance to familiarize yourself with your new Overseer responsibilities. There are a few aspects we want to make clear – after all, you are trying to save humanity and we can't have any mistakes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/62f8a85dfc9ead13bb0f1d7b10bd5cf0636285f4.png[/img]

When selecting candidates for the Ark, you need to make sure that only the best of the best are accepted. We do not, under any circumstances, want criminals, the chronically ill or anyone who is inept. Do not be swayed by bribes, as we will find out!

However, you need to keep an eye out for potential factory workers. While not everyone is suitable for the Ark, some will be perfect for manual labour. Just be careful not to select anyone that poses a security threat to the project.

And, finally, any person you deem to be unusable can be processed into fuel. Pay the price, keep our city nice.

Respectfully,
Committee of State Vigilance

notes.title: Vertical 5 - the future of all mankind
notes.notes:
Hello, new employee!

We need to address a serious matter. Recently, rumors have spread around the population of Vert-5 that the government is brutally exploiting its people and doing nothing to improve their plights. These are false.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/e65962e0e6f5eb10252b81b7e23e0c33aab821ab.png[/img]

We urge you to disregard these defamatory rumours. At Vertical 5, we have sacrificed much to stave off the extinction of humankind. Our species is faced with an overpopulation crisis, which has led to mass starvation in the wasteland. Without the infrastructure provided to all citizens of our beloved city, you would be wandering barren lands, soaking up radiation from nuclear fallout and fending yourself from bandits, but here you are – under the protective watch of the authorities.

The government wants to make a better world for all of us. In the comfort of Vertical 5, there is no hunger or wars, you have a job, and we shall all have salvation.

The price for it is high, but humanity will remember everyone that sacrificed themselves for the salvation of civilization. With your help, we will make it to Planet 42.

Respectfully,
Committee of State Vigilance

To further show our appreciation, we are extending the availability of the demo until June 27. What will you do to see the Ark completed and humankind reaching the stars? 

Sincerely,
Organs Please team
